notes.title: DAMN! 2025 v0.0.1 Proof of Concept Build Footage!
notes.notes: [p]Hey there everyone! It's Ranger, as usual.[/p][p]Before we begin, I want to make it clear.[/p][h2]THIS IS A PROOF OF CONCEPT MADE IN A WEEK OFF OF DAMN! NATION. THE FINAL GAME WILL NOT BE BUILT OFF DAMN! NATION AND WE'RE FOCUSING ON BUG-FIXES, POLISH, AND BALANCING BEFORE MAKING A VISUAL OVERHAUL THAT BRINGS THIS BUILD TO PC/CONSOLE LEVEL GRAPHICS.[/h2][p]We just wanted to show that we are working to bring DAMN! to life. So please, don't be mislead into thinking this is how the final game will look or fully play as. It's only been a week.[/p][previewyoutube="BpH8QXvoo6c;full"][/previewyoutube][p]Today I’m excited to share some updates on our in-progress Proof of Concept (POC) for DAMN! PC. Our engineers have been making strong progress over the past couple of weeks, and it’s already shaping up really well. These video clips showcase things such as entering a house and fighting some TOCs, combat in a house with more rooms, visiting Bob's Bargain Bazaar (and getting stuck due to killing enemies too fast, haha!), free roaming around the neighborhood, and finally, walking through the TOC Gate after defeating all TOCs, and fighting Sheriff Pickens![/p][p]If you’re not familiar, a Proof of Concept is a small, playable slice of the game that helps us show what we’re aiming to build to interested parties such as investors or publishers. These are usually internal-only, but we might share it with the community in the future to give you a quick taste of what DAMN! could look like on PC. But keep in mind, this has only been made in a week, and built on DAMN! Nation. So there's still lots of work to be done, especially to the visuals, to bring it up to snuff for a PC/Console title![/p][p]Right now, the POC includes all items from DAMN! Nation, except for one we temporarily removed while we fix an issue. It also features regular enemies, TOCs, and Sheriff Pickens. It’s not a perfect reflection of our final vision, but it comes close. You can enter houses, battle enemies inside, rescue TOCs, and open the boss gate to escape. We’re still using the DAMN! Nation HUD for now, but we’ll be replacing it soon. We’re exploring new layouts inspired by the “Transparent HUD” I posted about in our discord, as well as the centered HUD design from my other HUD concepts.[/p][p]Some systems are still being adjusted. For example, in DAMN! Nation, clearing all enemies would unlock the next door. That works well inside buildings, but it doesn’t quite fit the more open structure of the PC version. So we're aiming to lessen the effect of it. Alongside that, the way rooms are presented in this POC is entirely different from our plans for the final game. In the final game, you'd only see the room that you're inside of currently. You wouldn't see into other rooms like you can in this POC. We also need April's Dodge Weave character ability, alongside being able to throw M80s instead of just dropping them on the floor.[/p][p]Even in this early stage, it’s already a lot of fun. We’re using 4-directional aiming at the moment, but we’ve seen requests for 8-directional and plan to test that soon. I had a great time in one of my runs using the Pierce Diver, a low fire rate, high damage nozzle that plays like a sniper. It made for some really satisfying moments.[/p][p]Next up, we’re focusing on fixing bugs, adding music, and locking in the new HUD. We’ll keep posting screenshots and clips, so stay tuned. Once the build is in a solid place, I’ll upload a full video as well.[/p][p]Thanks for sticking with us.[/p][p]— Ranger[/p][p][/p]

notes.title: DAMN! Nation is in Early Access on iOS and Android!
notes.notes: [p]Hey there everyone! We’re glad to finally announce that DAMN! Nation has fully launched on both iOS and Android in early access![/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38507232/b92cc3734d9785bdd4c9953237615d207db09e05.png"][/img][/p][p]It’s as simple as going to either the [url="https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.cursefreestudios.damnnation&pcampaignid=web_share"]Google Play[/url] or [url="https://apps.apple.com/us/app/damn-nation/id6695727121"]iOS App Store[/url], and searching for “DAMN! Nation” in the search bar, and you’ll easily be able to install the game for free! We currently have one final EU Certification to complete before we’re available there, but we’ll update you as soon as we are! Keep in mind, we’re still in early access, so there might be bugs running around, and we’re also aiming to receive feedback to polish up the gameplay to make it the best game possible. Just for an example, we’ve began trying a style with a much faster fire-rate and higher enemy health, leading to much more dynamic battles.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38507232/3163abc152169b5d7beabf5501eb063978a34fa1.png"][/img][/p][p]So, if you want the earliest possible taste of the world of Demons Ate My Neighbors, give DAMN! Nation a chance! Nearly all items, enemies, and bosses appearing in this title are planned for DAMN! PC (PC/Console first, not mobile first!)[/p][p][/p][p]As a secondary reminder, join our [url="https://discord.com/invite/damn"]discord server[/url] for more news related to DAMN! PC and DAMN! Nation![/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38507232/052a1072390da65b0024a47bbe64e976d0ee6c41.png"][/img][/p]

notes.title: DAMN! PC is underway, demo coming in 2025!
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38507232/f02dfb5d562836c9cda19670b8de77d09f83b42a.png[/img]
Hey there everyone, as we close in on the full official release for [i]DAMN! Nation[/i] and exit Early Access, we’re preparing to gear up and shift some of our focus and resources over to the main event — [i]Demons Ate My Neighbors![/i], AKA [i]DAMN![/i]

[h2]Upcoming Community Address[/h2]

With us beginning to refocus on [i]Demons Ate My Neighbors![/i], it's important for us to be transparent to the community. A lot has happened behind the scenes, and now that legalities have cleared up, we want to tell our story. The story of DAMN!, how it was created as an idea, how it was (almost) destroyed by Covid 19, and how after 6 more years of industry experience, the returning members are ready to bring the game to life once again. We know DAMN! Nation was not the game you were waiting for, but as you'll learn in this upcoming Community Address, the source code for DAMN! '21 was sadly lost in the sands of time. The Nation Deal vitally allowed us to begin work for DAMN! PC, by letting us properly create code for Characters, Enemies, Mechanics, and even 85 brand-new items, all relatively without worry. Serving as a massive boost in our journey to create Demons Ate My Neighbors!

In this addressment we'll be discussing all that, and the future, in both text and video format. Because we feel like you all deserve to know, and we really want you to understand that we want this game just as much as you do, and we appreciate you all staying here as long as you have.

[h2]It's on our minds![/h2]

Currently, we're working to determine the future of [i]DAMN![/i] Such as what we're carrying over from Nation, what we're preserving from DAMN! '19-'21, and what we're planning for the 2025 Demo, and future release. (Elaborated below)

[h2]DAMN! PC vs DAMN! Nation[/h2]

Although it may be obvious, we want to absolutely set the record straight, and remind you all that [i]DAMN! PC[/i] and [i]DAMN! Nation[/i] are built for entirely different platforms, and thus will [b]NOT[/b] share the following features seen in Nation.

[list]
[*] Ads
[*] Any form of Web3 or Crypto integration
[*] Microtransactions
[*] An energy system
[*] Autoshooter gameplay
[/list]

With the creation of Nation though, many things introduced in it were always intended to appear in DAMN! PC, so whilst we had a paid budget, we made sure to create them!

[list]
[*] VH$ and the VH$Ending Machine
[*] Perma-Pops!
[*] All Enemies (Zombos, Bats, Vampunks, Zaplings, Tarmen, and Ohmlings.)
[*] Sheriff Pickens and The Ice Cream Man Bosses (Since Nation is a prequel and Joey will be playable in DAMN! PC, he can't be a boss in PC. We may find a way to preserve his boss behavior though.)
[*] All Citizens and Tuned Out Citizens! (Sergeant Sally, Gigi & Maurice, Margot Rita, Cheerleader Girl, and Father Romero.)
[*] All 85 Items (15 Actives, 11 Nozzles, and 55 Passives!)
[*] Romero Residences, both the outside streets and inside houses. Alongside Crystal Lake Mall. (Crystal Lake Mall actually had no graphics prior to Nation).
[*] All music tracks heard in Nation!
[/list]
and just to be clear...
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38507232/cfd2bd40338b941f59bc0eaebe32c3405b480576.png[/img]
[b][h1]DAMN! PC will be a TWIN STICK SHOOTER and have 2 PLAYER COOP[/h1][/b]

[h2][url=https://discord.com/servers/damn-1353799099459043449]You're involved in our future![/url][/h2]

We wouldn't be here if it wasn't for you. Literally. You may have noticed that our original Discord Server has been removed, this was due to an unfortunate hack we suffered, but we've gotten control back, and we'd greatly appreciate you rejoining so you can take advantage of these brand new features we've worked on to improve your server experience!

Just to list some of the changes:

[list]
[*] We have roles that you can choose to be pinged for only the projects you're interested in.
[*] We have a news forum where you can filter by only the news you're interested in.
[*] We've created a channel where you can post questions for us to answer about DAMN! PC or Nation.
[*] We've created a channel where we'll post possible changes we're considering for DAMN! PC, so we can get your valued opinion. Currently we're discussing the possibility of turning our characters from Pixel Art into Low Poly 3D Models, with various reasons behind this possible decision. Please, join and discuss with us!
[/list]

Alongside that, we'll also be posting more often about DAMN! PC in general, including more insights into it's Beta elements, such as mechanics, characters, items, and environments NEVER BEFORE REVEALED TO THE PUBLIC. Some of these may be cut forever, and some may be carried over! You'll just have to wait and see.

[h2]In Conclusion...[/h2]

The future of Demons Ate My Neighbors! is looking bright, and we're eager to share it with you. This isn't quite the end for DAMN! Nation, it's only just the beginning for DAMN! PC.

notes.title: 🔥 DAMN! Demons Ate My Neighbors! is BACK, BABY! 🔫
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38507232/f64086a1ad628c599019340e58a33fcff4473d03.gif[/img]
[h1]Hey Neighbors! 🧟[/h1]
After a longer and more complex hiatus than anyone could have predicted, we're beyond thrilled to announce that the DAMN! IP is making a fierce comeback with [b]two major game announcements![/b]

[h2]A Little Backstory[/h2]
In 2019, we launched a Kickstarter for [i]Demons Ate My Neighbors![/i] with big ambitions: to create a love letter to classic 90s run-and-gun games, spiced up with the intensity of roguelite shooters like [i]The Binding of Isaac[/i] and [i]Enter the Gungeon[/i], all mixed with the goofy co-op energy of [i]ToeJam & Earl[/i]. We were ready to bring you this vision—even got Macaulay Culkin involved! But after factoring in Kickstarter rewards, fees, and production costs, we realized we needed to scale up our resources to bring the full vision to life.

The challenges of COVID and the need for a clear plan led us to put the project on pause while we sharpened our focus. Today, we’re thrilled to share that we’ve secured outside support to relaunch the DAMN! project—and with fresh momentum, we’re announcing two titles currently in development: [i]DAMN! Nation[/i] and [i]Demons Ate My Neighbors![/i] 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38507232/aa90560e63d10f614cb9c7ac879246b8e207f35c.png[/img]

And that’s not all—Tuned-Out Games has evolved into [b]Curse Free Studios[/b], which will be producing and publishing all DAMN! IP titles moving forward!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38507232/e77d040cba4a48a06138b61a7cf9a6a132f69755.png[/img]
[h1]Introducing DAMN! Nation – Launching Early 2025[/h1]
[i]DAMN! Nation[/i] is a free-to-play mobile game, designed as a one-handed, single-player experience that introduces players to the world and characters of DAMN! Step into the shoes of April in this action-packed prologue to the main story of [i]Demons Ate My Neighbors![/i] 📲

[i]DAMN! Nation[/i] will launch in a closed beta this December and then will be available for public consumption early 2025. It will be available on iOS, Android, and Quest headsets (as a 2D app)
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38507232/88de63228c058dd8038982b8fec6bbd5963dd144.png[/img]
[b]While we have no plans to implement blockchain technology in Demons Ate My Neighbors!, when it comes to our partnership agreement for DAMN! Nation, we’re implementing blockchain technology to store run data, providing a transparent, public leaderboard to keep things fair and track performance trends.[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38507232/8ea47c3df43fdf9bde7c0e8bbb8b76bbd5dc6863.png[/img]

We know some players have concerns about this tech, but we want to be open from the start of our new relationship with you as a potential fan: it was the best path to secure funding and bring the IP back to life.

 [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38507232/e2fe5164b311dafc044def3d8cd0688b2047c06b.png[/img]

Rest assured, despite the blockchain implementation, this partnership has enabled us to make a game focused on fun first. It’s a completely optional feature that exists to add some transaction data to the chain alongside providing those who choose to opt in additional benefits such as achievements and token airdrops on a companion app.

Our new funding will bring [i]DAMN! Nation[/i] to life, with the hope that its success will pave the way for us to realize the original vision of [i]Demons Ate My Neighbors![/i] fully. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38507232/fc8819869161f18b95dc5abe00213fd8d06dcc5c.png[/img]

[h1]Looking Toward the Core Vision of Creating Demons Ate My Neighbors![/h1]
Our new funding will bring [i]DAMN! Nation[/i] to life, and we’re hopeful its success will pave the way for us to fully realize our original vision for [i]Demons Ate My Neighbors! [/i]

Our plan remains mostly the same - a fully fleshed out, “traditional” roguelike action game for 2-player co-op. We loved growing up with the vibes of [i]Zombies ate my Neighbors[/i], and have lost 100s of hours playing [i]The Binding of Isaac[/i], and if we can combine the complexity and depth with the wacky 90’s vibes, with just a pinch of [i]ToeJam & Earl[/i]’s kooky co-op funkiness, we think we have the recipe for something really special.

[b]Again, this will be the original vision that I think many of you originally became early fans of, and we hope if you’re not interested in DAMN! Nation, you’ll stay tuned for Demons Ate My Neighbors![/b]

Please consider wishlisting [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1372650/Demons_Ate_My_Neighbors/]Demons Ate My Neighbors![/url] on Steam and help us create the buzz we need to explore additional funding and publishing opportunities! 🎮

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38507232/fc8819869161f18b95dc5abe00213fd8d06dcc5c.png[/img]

Going forward, you can expect regular updates on both games, including details on gameplay, systems, and artwork. The vibe remains true to the original vision: in both [i]DAMN! Nation[/i] and [i]Demons Ate My Neighbors![/i], you’ll wield an upgradable squirt gun to cleanse the neighborhood of monstrous infestations in a dynamic, evolving roguelite world. 🧠💥

You’re the ones who inspired us to keep chasing this dream and hopefully bring it to reality one day. Join us on [url=http://discord.gg/damn]Discord[/url] to share your thoughts and let us know what you’d love to see next! 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38507232/7f6eee7bedd986d6498db9eb5ca0ecac2adc7c37.png[/img]
📩 Stay tuned for more updates & sneak peeks on our social channels!
[url=https://www.discord.gg/damn]Discord[/url], [url=http://x.com/@damnvideogame]X[/url], [url=https://www.facebook.com/demonsatemyneighbors]Facebook[/url], [url=https://www.instagram.com/demonsatemyneighbors/]Instagram[/url], as well as Curse Free Studios on Linkedin (ew) and YouTube, where we plan to upload some never-before-seen footage of some of [i]Demons Ate My Neighbors[/i]!'s prototypes!

We can't wait to show you more and your unearthly patience.

[b]Catch you on the flip side,[/b]
[i]Curse Free Studios [/i]
